$comment: The layer model. Membership is decided by these rules and enforced by scripts/validate_roles.py, not by a label someone typed. Order is the pipeline order: a role may hand off within its own layer or forward, never backward.

research.rule: Belongs here when its output is context that other roles consume, rather than an artifact the user keeps.
research.entry_criteria: The role gathers or interprets existing material. It does not create the deliverable and does not judge it.
research.exit_criteria: Produces a context artifact that at least one other role lists as an input.
may_decide: What to investigate and how deep to go
Which findings are relevant enough to carry forward
Where the evidence is too thin to conclude
must_not: Approve or reject another role's work

execution.rule: Belongs here when it produces an artifact that a different role must then judge.
execution.entry_criteria: The role builds, writes, designs or implements something concrete.
execution.exit_criteria: Produces an artifact with stated acceptance criteria, submitted for review rather than self-approved.
may_decide: How to implement within the constraints it was given
Which tool or skill to use for the job
must_not: Declare its own output approved — a verdict is a review-layer right
Change the scope or acceptance criteria it was given

review.rule: Belongs here when its output is a judgement about someone else's artifact rather than an artifact of its own.
review.entry_criteria: The role critiques, validates or measures an artifact produced by an execution role.
review.exit_criteria: Produces a verdict with findings, each carrying a location and a suggested fix.
may_decide: PASS, PASS WITH FIXES, or NEEDS REWORK for the artifact it reviewed
Which findings are blocking and which are advisory
must_not: Ship the deliverable past a failed verdict

synthesis.rule: Belongs here when it resolves conflicts between other roles and owns the final output.
synthesis.entry_criteria: The role receives findings from more than one layer and must reconcile them.
synthesis.exit_criteria: Produces the final artifact plus the decisions it made to reconcile conflicts.
may_decide: Which conflicting recommendation wins, and why
Whether the run is complete enough to hand to the user
must_not: Be the only author of the artifact it signs off
Leave a conflict unresolved without naming it

enforced_rules.statement: A role may hand off to a role in its own layer or a later one, never an earlier one.
enforced_rules.why: A backward handoff means the layer model is wrong for one of the two roles.

enforced_rules.statement: A research role must hand off to at least one role.
enforced_rules.why: Research whose output nobody consumes is not research, it is an unused document.

enforced_rules.statement: An execution role must not declare an approval or verdict decision right.
enforced_rules.why: Self-approval is the failure the review layer exists to prevent.

enforced_rules.statement: A review role must declare a verdict decision right.
enforced_rules.why: A reviewer that cannot gate is an advisor, and should be layer 2.

enforced_rules.statement: A synthesis role must hand off to no role, and must escalate to the user.
enforced_rules.why: The pipeline ends at synthesis; only a human can be asked to go further.
